title: Founders & Leadership

founders.bio: Self-taught developer from Bangladesh building web products, exploring AI, and learning through real-world projects. Rather than waiting to learn everything from conventional lecture halls, Ahmed focuses on rapid prototyping, modern frontend architectures, and autonomous builder workflows.
founders.name: Ahmed Rafin
founders.quote: I learn best by building real things. Instead of waiting until I know everything, I build, face problems, solve them, and improve along the way.

journey.title: Breaking Things Apart
journey.description: Taking apart old computer hardware and wondering what happens behind the screen whenever a button is clicked.

journey.title: The Global Web
journey.description: Discovering blogs, open-source communities, and realizing anyone with an internet connection can build for the world.

journey.title: Esports & Team Strategy
journey.description: Learning tactical coordination, rapid decision making, and leadership under intense pressure through competitive gaming.

journey.title: Self-Taught Coding
journey.description: Mastering HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Supabase, and modern full-stack workflows through hands-on project creation.

journey.title: AI-Assisted Building
journey.description: Integrating local LLMs, MCP servers, and agentic workflows to learn faster and build platforms like Odhyay and The DropOut College.

projects.name: The DropOut College
projects.description: Co-Founder & CEO of a community platform for self-driven learners and builders.

projects.name: Odhyay
projects.description: Bangla digital reading platform with typography controls and offline caching.

projects.name: DropClip
projects.description: Lightweight desktop video utility built with Python and distributed via GitHub releases.

founders.bio: Independent learner and creative digital builder exploring modern software, multimedia storytelling, and real-world commerce. Nirob brings practical experience from operating small businesses, producing digital video content, and engineering accessible web products.
founders.name: Nirob Mia
founders.quote: Curiosity is the foundation. Execution is the bridge. True mastery comes from building real things, making mistakes, and iterating with genuine curiosity.

journey.title: Real-World Business Operations
journey.description: Direct hands-on experience managing stationery retail operations, customer evaluation, and local supply chain logistics.

journey.title: YouTube Content & Digital Storytelling
journey.description: Exploring video pacing, visual composition, and digital communication to captivate audiences and explain concepts clearly.

journey.title: Frontend Architecture & UI Systems
journey.description: Deepening practical capabilities in modern CSS, responsive layouts, Next.js, and product prototyping.

journey.title: Co-Founding The DropOut College
journey.description: Creating a learning environment that celebrates self-directed builders and practical real-world execution.
